title: Logs Explorer
description: Kibana-style log exploration for Loki + Alloy: Discover histogram & log stream, breakdowns, ingress-nginx HTTP analytics and pipeline health.

list.name: search
list.label: Search (regex)
list.description: Case-insensitive RE2 line match, like the Kibana query bar. Empty = everything.

list.name: exclude
list.label: Exclude (regex)
list.description: Case-insensitive RE2; matching lines are hidden. Keep ^$ to exclude nothing — an empty box hides everything.

panels.title: Log lines
panels.description: All lines matching the current filters in the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"$level" [$__range]))

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: detected_level = error | critical | fatal (ignores the Level filter).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"error|critical|fatal" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: detected_level = warn | warning (ignores the Level filter).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"warn|warning" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Errors as a percentage of all lines (ignores the Level filter).

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"error|critical|fatal" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" [$__range]))

panels.title: Volume
panels.description: Raw bytes of matching log lines.

targets.expr: sum(bytes_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"$level" [$__range]))

panels.title: Pods logging
panels.description: Distinct pods that produced at least one matching line.

targets.expr: count(sum by (namespace, pod) (count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"$level" [$__range])))

panels.title: Log histogram
panels.description: Kibana-style hit histogram, stacked by detected log level. Drag to zoom.

targets.expr: sum by (detected_level) (count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"$level" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Logs
panels.description: Discover view. Expand a line for fields; use the +/- magnifiers to add ad-hoc filters. Search / Exclude are case-insensitive regex (RE2).

targets.expr: {namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"$level"

sum by (namespace) (count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"$level" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Levels
panels.description: Level split for the current filters (ignores the Level filter).

targets.expr: sum by (detected_level) (count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" [$__range]))

panels.title: Top sources
panels.description: Noisiest sources. Click a row to drill the whole dashboard into that namespace/container.

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (namespace, app, container) (count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"$level" [$__range])))

sum by (namespace, app, container) (count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"error|critical|fatal" [$__range]))

sum by (namespace, app, container) (bytes_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"$level" [$__range]))

panels.title: Top error messages
panels.description: Top values of the msg field (logfmt or JSON) on error lines — Kibana 'top values' equivalent.

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (namespace, msg) (count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"error|critical|fatal" | logfmt | __error__="" | msg!="" [$__range])) or sum by (namespace, msg) (count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"error|critical|fatal" | json msg | __error__="" | msg!="" [$__range])))

topk(10, sum by (pod) (count_over_time({namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"error|critical|fatal" [$__auto])))
{namespace=~"$namespace", app=~"$app", container=~"$container", pod=~"$pod", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)$search" !~ "(?i)$exclude" | detected_level=~"error|critical|fatal|warn|warning"

sum(count_over_time({namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" [$__range])) / $__range_s

100 * (sum(count_over_time({namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" | status=~"5.." [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" [$__range]))

100 * (sum(count_over_time({namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" | status=~"4.." [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" [$__range]))

quantile_over_time(0.95, {namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" | status!="101" | unwrap request_time | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

sum(sum_over_time({namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [$__range]))

sum by (status_class) (count_over_time({namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" | label_format status_class=`{{ substr 0 1 .status }}xx` [$__auto]))

quantile_over_time(0.50, {namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" | status!="101" | unwrap request_time | __error__="" [$__auto]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" | status!="101" | unwrap request_time | __error__="" [$__auto]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.99, {namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" | status!="101" | unwrap request_time | __error__="" [$__auto]) by ()

sum by (upstream) (count_over_time({namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" [$__range]))

sum by (upstream) (count_over_time({namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" | status=~"5.." [$__range]))

quantile_over_time(0.95, {namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" | status!="101" | unwrap request_time | __error__="" [$__range]) by (upstream)

topk(20, sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" | label_format route=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*" .path "" }}` [$__range])))

topk(20, sum by (status, method, route) (count_over_time({namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" | status=~"[45].." | label_format route=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*" .path "" }}` [$__range])))

topk(15, sum by (user_agent) (count_over_time({namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" [$__range])))

{namespace="ingress-nginx", container="controller"} |~ "(?i)$search" | pattern `<client> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<user_agent>" <_> <request_time> [<upstream>] [<_>] <_>` | status=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" | status!="101" | request_time > 1
sum(rate(loki_distributor_bytes_received_total{namespace="logging"}[5m]))
sum(rate(loki_distributor_lines_received_total{namespace="logging"}[5m]))
sum(loki_ingester_memory_streams{namespace="logging"})

panels.title: Alloy dropped
panels.description: Entries Alloy gave up sending to Loki.

targets.expr: sum(increase(loki_write_dropped_entries_total{namespace="logging"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Loki discarded
panels.description: Samples Loki rejected (rate limits, too old, line too long…).

targets.expr: sum(increase(loki_discarded_samples_total{namespace="logging"}[$__range])) or vector(0)
count(alloy_build_info{namespace="logging"})
sum by (pod) (rate(loki_write_sent_bytes_total{namespace="logging"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (reason) (rate(loki_write_dropped_entries_total{namespace="logging"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (reason) (rate(loki_discarded_samples_total{namespace="logging"}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(loki_write_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="logging"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(loki_write_entry_propagation_latency_seconds_bucket{namespace="logging"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, route) (rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="logging", route=~"loki_api_v1_push|loki_api_v1_query_range|loki_api_v1_query|loki_api_v1_index_volume.*|loki_api_v1_series|loki_api_v1_labels"}[$__rate_interval])))
sum by (route) (rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="logging", status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (pod) (alloy_resources_process_resident_memory_bytes{namespace="logging"})
sum by (pod) (rate(alloy_resources_process_cpu_seconds_total{namespace="logging"}[$__rate_interval]))
